d: Journey into the heart of the ancient Middle East to unlock the secrets of the Nabataean Kingdom. In this full episode of Lost Treasures of Arabia from National Geographic, join archaeologists as they excavate the legendary stone-carved cities of Petra and Hegra in modern-day Jordan and Saudi Arabia. Uncover grand architectural marvels, ancient trade networks, and complex urban planning. From intricate burial customs to geopolitical dynamics and the mysterious decline of Hegra, explore how ongoing research is piecing together one of history's most fascinating ancient civilizations.
